definition: a strong metal made of iron and a little carbon
description: A long curved steel slide runs down a green mountain meadow, its polished grey chute filling the bottom half of the frame, with dark pine forest and hills behind. A spotted fawn lies curled up in the steel chute at the top of the slide. It sits up and looks straight down the slide at the camera with its ears out, settles back down into the chute, then gets to its feet and walks off into the tall grass beside the slide.
